skill.summary: Auto-generate beautiful changelogs from git history, grouped by conventional commit types

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of git-changelog.
- Generates categorized, markdown changelogs from git history following conventional commits.
- Supports flexible range selection (by tag, date, or number of commits).
- Groups commit messages by type (features, fixes, docs, etc.), auto-detects breaking changes.
- Handles edge cases like missing tags, custom paths (monorepos), or non-conventional commits.
- Outputs to chat or can write/prepend to CHANGELOG.md on request.
